focus: can /kən/ (weak) vs can't /kɑːnt/ · -ing endings /ɪŋ/ and /ŋ/ vs /n/ · initial clusters (play, from, swim) · /juː/ (music) vs /uː/ (food) · /ð/ /θ/ in with, think
focus_ar: can الخفيفة مقابل can't، ونهايات -ing، والتجمعات الساكنة في البداية، و /juː/ مقابل /uː/
arabic_challenge: Arabic does not allow consonant clusters at the start of a word, so 'play' becomes 'be-lay' and 'swim' becomes 'se-wim'. The can/can't contrast is also hard because English weakens 'can' but stresses 'can't' — the vowel, not just the /t/, carries the difference.

isolation.instructions: In a positive sentence, 'can' is WEAK and quick: /kən/ — 'I can swim' sounds like 'I k'n swim'. 'Can't' is STRESSED with a long, full vowel: /kɑːnt/. Listen for the VOWEL, not just the /t/.
isolation.instructions_ar: في الجملة المثبتة 'can' خفيفة وسريعة /kən/. أما 'can't' فمنبورة وحرف العلة فيها طويل. الفرق في حرف العلة مش بس في /t/.

sentence_practice: I can swim but I can't drive.
She can cook but she can't sing.
We can play football but we can't play tennis.
daily_drills.record_this: I can swim but I can't drive. She can cook very well but she can't sing. We can play football but we can't play tennis.
daily_drills.self_check: Ask a friend to say whether they heard 'can' or 'can't'. Were they right every time?

isolation.instructions: /ŋ/ (-ing) is made at the BACK of the mouth — the same place as /k/ and /g/ — with air through the nose. /n/ is at the FRONT, tongue tip up. 'Reading' must end in /ɪŋ/, never /ɪn/.
isolation.instructions_ar: /ŋ/ بيتعمل في مؤخرة الفم (نفس مكان /k/) والهوا من المناخير. /n/ في المقدمة وطرف اللسان لأعلى. 'reading' لازم تنتهي بـ /ɪŋ/.

daily_drills.record_this: I like reading and singing in my free time. She is playing football and running in the park. We enjoy swimming and cooking together.
daily_drills.self_check: Say 'sing' and hold the last sound. Is it made at the BACK of your mouth?

isolation.instructions: English starts words with two or three consonants together: play, please, from, free, swim, sport, study. Arabic inserts a vowel — resist it. Say the consonants back-to-back with no vowel between.
isolation.instructions_ar: الإنجليزي يبدأ الكلمة بساكنين أو تلاتة: play، from، swim. العربي بيحشر حركة — قاوم. نطقهم ورا بعض بدون حركة.

sentence_practice: I play sport in my free time.
daily_drills.record_this: I play sport in my free time and I practice every day. Please come with my friend — we can swim and study together.
daily_drills.self_check: Count the syllables in 'play'. Exactly ONE. If you hear two, you added a vowel.

isolation.instructions: /juː/ (music, use, beautiful, computer) begins with a /j/ glide — 'yoo'. /uː/ (food, school) has no /j/. Adding or dropping the /j/ changes the word.
isolation.instructions_ar: /juː/ (music) بتبدأ بزحلقة /j/ — 'يو'. /uː/ (food) مفيهاش /j/. إضافة أو حذف /j/ بيغيّر الكلمة.

sentence_practice: I use my computer at school.
daily_drills.record_this: I usually listen to beautiful music in my free time. I use my computer at school, and soon I will move to a new room.
daily_drills.self_check: Say 'music'. Does it start with a clear 'yoo' glide?

isolation.instructions: Both put the tongue between the teeth. /θ/ (think, thing, three) has NO voice. /ð/ (with, they, the, other) HAS voice. Free-time language uses both constantly: 'I think I'll go with them.'
isolation.instructions_ar: الاتنين اللسان بين الأسنان. /θ/ بدون صوت (think). /ð/ بصوت (with, they). لغة وقت الفراغ فيها الاتنين كتير.

sentence_practice: I think I can do three things.
daily_drills.record_this: I think I can do three things in my free time: read, swim and play with my friends. They usually do nothing on their birthday.
daily_drills.self_check: Say 'with them'. Both 'th' sounds must be voiced, with the tongue visible.

challenge_sentences: I can swim but I can't drive.
I like reading, singing and playing sport.
I usually listen to music with my friends.
I think I can play three games.
daily_drills.record_this: I can swim but I can't drive. I like reading, singing and playing sport in my free time. I usually listen to beautiful music with my friends, and I think I can play three different games.
daily_drills.self_check: Check three things: is 'can' weak and 'can't' strong, does every -ing end at the back of the mouth, and are clusters vowel-free?

test_yourself.instructions: Record yourself talking about abilities and free time. Then listen back and check each sound group.
test_yourself.instructions_ar: سجّل نفسك وانت تتكلم عن قدراتك ووقت فراغك، وبعدين اسمع وراجع كل مجموعة أصوات.
test_yourself.passage: I can speak Arabic and English, but I can't speak French. In my free time I like reading, swimming and playing football. I usually listen to music on my computer. My friend can play the guitar but she can't sing. We often study together and practice English. I think free time is important. On Friday we go swimming in the pool, and then we watch a beautiful film.

sounds_to_check.can vs can't: I can speak / I can't speak — she can play / she can't sing
sounds_to_check.-ing /ɪŋ/: reading, swimming, playing, listening, studying, watching
sounds_to_check.initial clusters: speak, free, playing, French, study, practice, swimming
sounds_to_check./juː/ vs /uː/: music, usually, computer, beautiful — pool, food, school
sounds_to_check./θ/ vs /ð/: think, three, Friday? no — with, they, together, the

scoring_guide.90_100: can/can't is unmistakable, every -ing is /ɪŋ/, no inserted vowels. Ready for week 10.
scoring_guide.50_69: can/can't confusable, or vowels inserted into clusters. Repeat days 1 and 3.
scoring_guide.below_50: Redo days 1-5, slowing the clusters right down before speeding up.

for_arabic_speakers: Arabic forbids initial clusters — this is a structural habit, so it needs deliberate slow practice, not just awareness.
'can' is weak in positive sentences; 'can't' is strong with a long vowel. Listeners rely on the VOWEL more than the /t/.
-ing must end at the BACK of the mouth (/ŋ/). Ending with /n/ is a very audible accent marker.
Do not drop the /j/ in 'music' or 'computer'.
supplementary_notes.recording_requirement: Record the 'record_this' line daily; compare day 7 with day 1.
